SUSPENSION AND AXLE -- FRONT LOWER BALL JOINT
REMOVAL
1. REMOVE STEERING KNUCKLE WITH AXLE HUB
(see page SA-12}
2. REMOVE LOWER BALL JOINT
(a) Remove the cotter pin and nut.
(b) Using SST, remove the lower bait joint.
